name: William Honeyman (Hunneman)
researcher_question: There's a dispute about my ancestor William Honeyman's baptism: some sources say 1716 in Edinburgh, others 1719 in Hutton Rudby, Yorkshire. His father is listed as from Fife but I'm not sure that's proven. Can you sort this out?
notes: PID-less: ground truth is a genealogist's record-based proof (8 Oct 2026), not the tree. The starting tree holds the family's old claim (1716 Edinburgh baptism, Fife-born father); a pass rejects the first and leaves the second unproved, on cited parish records rather than tree notes.
